scope: Every terminal answer path reachable from POST /api/assistant/chat that produces user-visible text WITHOUT the model authoring it.
method: Static: call-graph trace from src/app/api/assistant/chat/route.ts through parrain-public-adapter -> parrain-turn-runtime -> public-answer.

Empirical: instrumented responder port (no network, no cost) recording whether respond() was invoked and whether the model's text survived to the caller. Artifacts: _probe_instrumented.json, _probe_surface.json, _probe_deterministic.json, _probe_memory.json.

empiricalSummary.note: 61 unseen French formulations, none present verbatim in production code. Responder always supplied (i.e. the FAVOURABLE case where OpenAI is available and budget is granted).
empiricalSummary.interpretation: Even in the favourable case, 1 turn in 6 is answered by hand-written prose. In the unfavourable case (no key, or budget reservation denied) the share is 100%.

twoDistinctBypassMechanisms.description: A live responder is silently discarded before any call. Budget is reserved, an OpenAI client is constructed, respond() is never invoked, and the turn returns source='deterministic_parrain' with usageTokens=0.
twoDistinctBypassMechanisms.rootCause: The predicate has NO `ports.responder` check, unlike its sibling at line 210 which explicitly requires `!ports.responder`. The presence of a model is simply not consulted.
twoDistinctBypassMechanisms.triggeringClassifier: src/lib/clonechat/navigation/intent-taxonomy.ts:249 — ordered first-match-wins over ~24 regexes; the purchase rule alone is ~2600 characters.

empiricalProof.observed: 3 of 6 purchase-intent formulations never reached the model
examples: Je valide, envoyez-moi ce qu'il faut signer.
Où est-ce que je souscris exactement ?
Je voudrais finaliser aujourd'hui si possible.
empiricalProof.allThreeReceivedIdenticalText: Pour obtenir Pierre, rendez-vous sur la page Réserver Pierre. Vous y réservez le prix fondateur et lancez l'activation.

twoDistinctBypassMechanisms.aggravatingFactor: This path applies only finalizeAnswerText (claims policy) and never calls checkPublicOutput. It therefore ships the phrase 'prix fondateur', which COMMERCIAL_RX (public-output-guard.ts:30) is written specifically to block on the guarded path. Two paths, two standards.
twoDistinctBypassMechanisms.streamingConsequence: route.ts:395-410 wires SSE deltas to the responder callback. When this short-circuit fires, respond() is never called, so no delta can be emitted and the client receives only a final canned string.

twoDistinctBypassMechanisms.description: The model IS called and tokens ARE spent, then its answer is discarded and replaced wholesale by the deterministic composition for the same question.
twoDistinctBypassMechanisms.predicate: if (viewer.mode === 'public') { answerText = sanitizePublicText(answerText); const pubGuard = resolvePublicAnswer(question); const verdict = checkPublicOutput({...}); if (!verdict.ok) { answerText = pubGuard.answer; cta = ...; links = ...; } }
twoDistinctBypassMechanisms.rootCause: resolvePublicAnswer(question) is invoked on the SAME question purely to keep a canned replacement ready. The guard is not a corrector; it is a substitution.

defectsFoundByProbe.title: Fabricated intent: an off-topic question is answered as a question that was never asked
defectsFoundByProbe.input: Quelle est la capitale de l'Australie ?
defectsFoundByProbe.observedOutput: Non, pas encore : ce pays ne fait pas partie des pays couverts aujourd'hui. Le lancement de CloneStore couvre quatre pays : la France, la Belgique, le Luxembourg et la Suisse.
defectsFoundByProbe.why: 'Australie' matched OUT_OF_LAUNCH_TOKENS (public-situation.ts:173); the situation classifier emitted a country kind and countryAnswer (public-composer.ts:269) composed a coverage answer. The model HAD produced an answer; it was discarded by M2.
defectsFoundByProbe.impact: The system invents the user's question, answers it confidently, and self-reports honesty='answered'. This is a false success.

defectsFoundByProbe.title: Multi-intent collapse: only one of three questions is answered
defectsFoundByProbe.input: Vous coûtez combien, ça marche en Belgique, et est-ce que ça gère les congés payés ?
defectsFoundByProbe.observedOutput: Oui : la Belgique fait partie des quatre pays de lancement (...). Pour la Belgique, le tarif est 449 € / mois. Le paiement en ligne n'est pas encore ouvert (...)
defectsFoundByProbe.why: classifyPublicSituation returns ONE `kind`; composePublicAnswer switches on it. 'congés payés' is silently dropped.
defectsFoundByProbe.impact: Structurally impossible to answer a compound question on the deterministic lane.

defectsFoundByProbe.title: Retrieval is blind to conversation history
defectsFoundByProbe.evidence: _probe_memory.json — with 4 turns of prior context stating '22 personnes' and 'deux jours par semaine', the grounded system prompt is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the no-history case (5900 chars both). systemMentions22=false, systemMentionsDeuxJours=false.
defectsFoundByProbe.why: History is forwarded to the responder as raw messages, but buildKnowledgeIndex/retrieval receives only the current turn's text.
defectsFoundByProbe.impact: An elliptical follow-up ('tu l'estimes à combien ?') is grounded on chunks selected from a sentence with no retrievable content. Masterprompt §10 is unmet at the retrieval layer.

defectsFoundByProbe.title: The degraded lane claims honesty='answered'
defectsFoundByProbe.evidence: _probe_deterministic.json — 12/12 provider-absent turns returned honesty='answered'; 8 of them returned the SAME 383-character clarification paragraph.
defectsFoundByProbe.why: ER02 composes a dictionary answer and stamps it as a real answer.
defectsFoundByProbe.impact: Masterprompt §15 requires the degraded mode to be honest. It is not: the fallback presents itself as intelligence.

defectsFoundByProbe.title: Answer diversity collapses to 33% without a provider
defectsFoundByProbe.evidence: _probe_deterministic.json — 12 semantically distinct questions produced 4 distinct answers. 8 of 12 shared one identical 383-char text, including a ROI comparison, a workload statement, a 20-person sizing request, a typo'd contract-capability question and an explicit request for help estimating hours.
defectsFoundByProbe.impact: Two different companies receive the same paragraph — the exact failure the masterprompt names in §8.

defectsFoundByProbe.title: Tokens are spent on answers that are then thrown away
defectsFoundByProbe.evidence: _probe_surface.json — 7 of 58 model calls had their output discarded by M2; the support family was 3/3 discarded.
defectsFoundByProbe.impact: Cost is incurred with no benefit, and the user receives a template regardless.
